info.titleNullable: NBA, NHL and College Basketball Results and Odds
info.subtitleNullable: 178,000 games from 1998 to 2026 with average and bookmaker closing moneylines
info.descriptionNullable:
## About this dataset

This dataset holds 178,245 NBA, NHL and NCAA men's basketball games from January 1998 to October 2026, each with its final score and period scores.

Most NHL games since 1998 and NBA games since 2009 carry the average closing price across bookmakers (three-way for hockey, so you get the draw in regulation as well). College basketball adds closing moneylines from named bookmakers for tens of thousands of games. It is a long, simple history for studying home advantage, upsets and market calibration across three sports.

## Files

Every table comes as CSV and as Parquet with the same content. The Parquet files are smaller and load faster. Everything joins on `game_id`.

| Table | Rows | One row per |
|---|---:|---|
| `games` | 178,245 | game, with teams, scores and coverage flags |
| `closing_odds` | 221,010 | game, bookmaker, market and line at the close |
| `data_dictionary` | 27 | column of the other tables, with its meaning |

## Coverage

Games per competition, the share with closing odds, and the first and last month covered.

| Competition | Games | With odds | First | Last |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| NCAA Men | 103,048 | 37% | 2008-11 | 2026-04 |
| NBA | 37,902 | 0% | 1998-01 | 2026-10 |
| NHL | 37,295 | 0% | 1998-01 | 2026-10 |

## Good to know

- Period columns are quarters for the NBA, halves for college basketball and periods for the NHL; `home_ot` and `away_ot` hold overtime and shootout goals.
- NBA prices start in 2009. College basketball prices vary by season, with the fullest coverage in recent years.
- Hockey averages are three-way prices for the result after 60 minutes; named bookmaker prices are listed with their market in `closing_odds`.
- Only dates are given, without start times.

## How it was collected

The data was collected in October 2026 by web scraping publicly accessible odds comparison, results and statistics websites, then parsed into the tables above. Prices, scores and statistics are kept as published. Nothing is estimated or filled in, and a value the source did not publish is left empty. Odds are decimal, rounded to three places.
